---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new tool for ErgonPDF
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what tool, capability, or user interface improvement you want to happen.

**Category of the Tool / Feature**
- [ ] Organize (Merge, Split, Rearrange, etc.)
- [ ] Edit & Sign (Sign, Annotate, Watermark, Forms, etc.)
- [ ] Create & Capture (Blank PDF, Camera Scan, HTML, QR, etc.)
- [ ] Convert (PDF to Images, Images to PDF, Word/Excel extraction, PDF/A, etc.)
- [ ] Compress & Repair (Compress, Flatten, Repair, Web-Optimize, etc.)
- [ ] Security & Privacy (Encrypt, Unlock, Redact, Metadata Scrubber, etc.)
- [ ] OCR & Scan (Local OCR text recognition)
- [ ] View & Compare (Side-by-side diffing, high-res viewer)
- [ ] Local AI Studio (Client-side heuristics, search, summary)
- [ ] Desktop / Offline Installer (Windows batch scripts, shortcuts)

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered (e.g., how Adobe Acrobat, ILovePDF, or Stirling-PDF handles this).

**Offline & Privacy Compatibility**
Can this feature run 100% in-browser using WebAssembly / JavaScript without requiring a backend server?
- [ ] Yes, 100% local client-side processing
- [ ] Requires clarification on engine dependencies

**Additional context**
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or specifications about the feature request here.
